klLanding.schultage_blockwochen_pruefungstermine_u: School days, block weeks, exam dates and subjects arrive on every phone without anyone typing a thing. And your messages reach the class without a WhatsApp group.
klLanding.kostenlos_und_werbefrei_sie_brauchen: Free and ad-free. You need a MyWorkLog account, your trainees don’t.
klLanding.genau_diese_ansicht_sehen_ihre: This is exactly what your trainees see after scanning. If a device already has something different, it shows what would be replaced.
klLanding.wochentage_auch_alle_zwei_wochen: Weekdays, also every two weeks from a date.
klLanding.jeder_werktag_im_block_zaehlt: Every weekday in a block counts as a school day.
klLanding.ueber_das_bundesland_damit_freie: Via the federal state, so days off don’t count as missing.
klLanding.teil_1_teil_2_und: Part 1, part 2 and registration deadline in the IHK view.
klLanding.werden_ergaenzt_vorhandene_noten_bleiben: Added on top, existing grades stay.
klLanding.und_danach_aendert_sich_der: And afterwards: if the plan changes, the app asks the next time it opens. Short messages from the teacher appear in the notifications.
klLanding.brauchen_meine_azubis_ein_konto: Do my trainees need an account?
klLanding.nein_sie_scannen_den_qrcode: No. They scan the QR code or enter the code. Only whoever creates the class needs an account.
klLanding.was_passiert_wenn_sich_der: What happens when the timetable changes?
klLanding.sie_aendern_das_klassenprofil_beim: You edit the class profile. The next time the app opens, a notice appears, and each trainee decides whether to apply the change.
klLanding.kann_ich_der_klasse_nachrichten: Can I send messages to the class?
klLanding.ja_kurze_mitteilungen_bis_500: Yes, short messages up to 500 characters, optionally with an expiry date. They appear in the app notifications.
klLanding.was_wenn_der_code_in: What if the code gets into the wrong hands?
klLanding.erzeugen_sie_einen_neuen_code: Create a new code. The old link and the old QR code stop working. Anyone who already joined stays connected.
klLanding.nein_myworklog_ist_kostenlos_und: No. MyWorkLog is free and ad-free, also for schools and companies.

klStage.beispiel_die_beameransicht_zeigt_den: Example: the projector view shows the code, the class’s phones set themselves up one after another.

warum.einmal_anlegen_statt_30mal_erklaeren: Set it up once instead of explaining it 30 times
warum.schultage_rhythmus_blockwochen_bundeslan: School days, rhythm, block weeks, federal state, exam dates and subjects come with the code. Whether Friday is a school day is answered by the app from now on.
warum.berichtsheft_und_stunden_rechnen_richtig: Report book and hours count correctly
warum.weil_die_schultage_stimmen_zaehlt: Because the school days are right, vocational school counts as school in the report book and the time tracking, not as a missing workday. The countdown to the final exam runs to the same date for everyone.
warum.berichtsheft_bis_freitag_mitbringen_ersc: “Bring your report book by Friday” appears in every trainee’s app. No private phone numbers, no group chat, no replies at midnight.
warum.sie_sehen_wie_viele_dabei: You see how many are in. Nothing else.
warum.keine_namen_keine_arbeitszeiten_keine: No names, no working hours, no report books. Joins are counted with a random identifier that cannot be linked to a person. Trainees’ data stays on their devices.

code.er_steht_an_der_tafel: It’s on the board or the handout, eight characters.

mainEntity.name: Do my trainees need an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Trainees scan the QR code or enter the eight-character code. MyWorkLog sets itself up on their device. Only the teacher or trainer who creates the class needs an account.

mainEntity.name: What does the teacher see of the trainees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just a number: how many devices joined the class. No names, no working hours, no report books. Joins are counted with a random device identifier that cannot be linked to a person.

mainEntity.name: What is set up on the devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: School days including rhythm, block teaching, the federal state for public holidays, the dates of the final exam part 1 and part 2, and the subjects and learning fields of the year. Before joining, every trainee sees what changes and can deselect individual items.

mainEntity.name: What happens when the timetable changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The teacher edits the class profile. The next time trainees open the app they see a notice, and each one decides whether to apply the change.

mainEntity.name: Can I send messages to the class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, short messages such as “Please bring your report book by Friday”. They appear in the app notifications. Anyone who does not want them can turn them off in the notification settings.
No. MyWorkLog is free and ad-free, also for schools and companies.
